mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is a consistent positive predictor of S&P 500 20-day forward returns; the signal is always active without threshold conditions, and the direction is fixed as positive due to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of observations, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative market sentiment and producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3% occurs but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) signals a 'dovish' monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Joint condition (FEDFUNDS < 4.0% AND CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) occurs but 20-day returns are positive in more than 30% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), sustained economic expansion without inflationary pressures consistently produces positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.5% occurs but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2000 occurs but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in the supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105 occurs but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high housing starts (HOUST > 2000) and high residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 350000 million dollars) signals robust consumer and business demand, leading to positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Joint condition (HOUST > 2000 AND RSAFS > 350000) occurs but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in non-farm employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 100 thousand persons, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS monthly change > 100 occurs but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
